title: Top-K / Kth element
learn: size-k heap, heap vs sort vs quickselect trade-offs
hook: Kth Largest Element, K Closest Points and Top K Frequent are asked constantly, usually with the follow-up "can you beat O(n log n)?". The size-k heap and quickselect are the two answers you need.

explain.prompt: Explain how you'd find the k-th largest element, comparing sorting, a size-k heap and quickselect.
keyPoints: sorting: O(n log n), then index
min-heap of size k: push each value, pop when size exceeds k; the root is the k-th largest; O(n log k) time, O(k) space
use a MIN-heap for the k LARGEST (the root is the one to beat)
quickselect: partition around a pivot and recurse into the side with the target index; O(n) average, O(n²) worst
